headline: 004dfb70 is the single handler for state requests 0Ah and 0Bh and performs the whole mission scene load synchronously: it tears down the front end, raises the loading screen in mode 1, loads the scene file in three passes, builds the world and the global subsystems, runs the mission Lua, loads the spoken-warning banks, ends the loading screen and leaves game+5D4h = 0Ch. State 0Dh is reached the next frame by 004da6c0, out of the state 0Ch handler 004db920.

corrections_offered: The free helpers 00bf65ac and 00bf6989 are annotated no-return in Ghidra. That makes the decompiler emit spurious return statements throughout 004dfb70 and drop reachable blocks (004e1353..004e1373 is missing from the listing dump). Every case checked falls through in the raw listing. Clearing the annotation would fix every SEH-heavy function in this area.
0057d0c0 is tagged cg_static_dtor_stub but is a one-caller forwarder to BSP_LoadingScreen_PublishConfig (0057cff0) used by 004dfb70 to publish the loading-screen configuration before mode 1.

follow_up_packets.contract: The .scn reader: its three passes, the record it fills, the entity and terrain keys it recognises.
game+19CCh and game+21D4h: sizes, constructors, ocean and sky bring-up, Ocean initialization failed.
The Lua host at game+1A08h: file load, named entry-point dispatch, the game+644h re-entry guard.
The scene list at game+5F0h/5F4h, how 004e1d70 builds a record, and the 0120h side blocks.
State 0Ch and the 0Ch to 0Dh transition, including the one-shots 004da6c0 arms.
The spoken-warning bank eviction pass and the DL_Content_0000062 switch.
